Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Episode.description: A span during which a tracked observable was positive.

duration.description: Observed duration, including the observed part of an open episode.

end.description: Open at the end of observation when absent.

start.description: Time the observable became positive; 0 if it was positive initially.

FinalInstances.description: The instances present at the end of one kept replicate.

instances.description: Instances with a positive count, sorted by type and attributes.

InstanceRecord.description: One instance: a type, its attribute values and its copy number.

attributes.description: One value per attribute of the type, in declared order.

count.description: Copy number, at least 1 for a final instance. Event log participants always have count 1.

LogEntry.description: One retained event of the event log.

firings.description: For a leap, `[rule index, firings]` pairs, one per lowered channel that fired; empty for an exact step.

observables.description: Every observable after the event, in the result's column order.

products.description: Produced instances of an exact step, one per product, each with count 1; a product that copies a reactant appears in both lists. Empty for a leap.

reactants.description: Consumed instances of an exact step, one per reactant pattern, each with count 1. Empty for a leap.

rule.description: Index into the result's `rules` for an exact step; absent for a leap.

time.description: Simulated time of the event; for a leap, the end of the leap.

Method.description:
The simulation method of a run request, tagged by `kind`.

Absent means `tree`. Each method reports its own sampler identity in the result's `sampler`; the same seed gives different trajectories under different samplers. Every method except `tree` needs a model that lowers to fixed instance tuples (`CRN-R020` at `/method` otherwise).

oneOf.description: Exact direct method over dynamic instances: rules are selected by their propensities, then instances from sum trees. Supports random product attributes and `new_id()`. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-direct/2`.

Exact direct method over the lowered network of fixed instance tuples and channels. Every positive channel must be at least 2^-53 of the total (`CRN-R031`). Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-static-direct/1`. Ziggurat waits change the prefix to `chacha8-u53-ziggurat`, and effective sparse trackers change the suffix to `rules-static-direct-sparse-trackers/1`. From rules-run/0.6 both are the default: `waiting_time: "inverse"` with `sparse_trackers: false` runs the default of rules-run/0.5.

sparse_trackers.description: rules-run/0.4 and later. `true` integrates unweighted single-class count trackers without first-passage predicates over their constant spans, which can change the last bits of an integral. Without such a tracker it changes nothing and warns with `CRN-R051`. `false` integrates every tracker at every event. Absent means `false` before rules-run/0.6; from 0.6 it integrates the eligible trackers sparsely and, without one, runs the per-event path without a warning. `null` is rejected.

waiting_time.description: rules-run/0.4 and later. Absent selects inverse waits before rules-run/0.6 and Ziggurat waits from 0.6. `null` is rejected.

oneOf.description: rules-run/0.3 and later. Exact grouped direct method for the fixed three-class mtDNA vacancy model, sampler `chacha8-u53-ziggurat/rules-mtdna-direct/1`. A model or parameter set it cannot certify runs Static Direct instead, with that sampler identity and a `CRN-R051` warning naming the reason.
Exact next reaction method with indexed clocks over the lowered channels. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-next-reaction/1`.
Exact thinning with the analytic ATP flow of a rules-model/0.2 model; required for ATP models and refused for others. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-atp-thinning/1`.
Approximate adaptive Poisson leaps with exact fallback steps. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-cgp-poisson/2`.

epsilon.description: Leap tolerance, in (0, 0.1] (`CRN-R020` otherwise): the step selection bounds the mean and spread of each species and rate change in one leap by this fraction of its current value.

oneOf.description: Approximate death-then-birth splitting on the fixed lattice `k * step`, for single-parent unit births and deaths only. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-binomial-split/2`.

step.description: Lattice step in simulated time, finite and positive (`CRN-R020` otherwise).

oneOf.description: rules-run/0.5 and later. Piecewise-deterministic simulation of a closed model with continuous variables (rules-model/0.3): between events the variables and the integrated total propensity follow an adaptive Dormand–Prince 5(4) integration, and the next event happens where the integrated propensity reaches a unit exponential threshold, located on the dense output. Approximate at the given tolerances; sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-hybrid-dopri54/1`. Also runs models without continuous variables. Refuses ATP models (use `thinning`) and models that do not lower to fixed tuples.

atol.description: Absolute tolerance of the error control, in (0, 1e-2] (`CRN-R020` otherwise). It applies to every variable and to the integrated propensity, which runs from 0 to a unit exponential.

rtol.description: Relative tolerance of the error control, in [1e-12, 1e-2] (`CRN-R020` otherwise).

Observation.description: The trackers and event log of one replicate, in the result's `observations`.

trackers.description: One result per requested tracker, in request order.

PathSeries.description: The observable series of one kept replicate.

values.description: report time × observable: one row per saved report time, with the columns in the order of `observables`.

Quantile.description: One quantile statistic of a `crn-craft.result/1.0` result.

values.description: report time × observable: the linear-interpolation quantile of the replicates' values (NumPy's default, type 7).

Record.description: The accounting of one replicate. Every replicate has a record, including replicates that a cancellation or the wall-time limit kept from starting.

created_instances.description: Instances created by events (excluding the initial state).

diagnostic.description: The limit or numerical error that ended the replicate; `null` for a completed or stopped replicate.

events.description: Events executed. Approximate methods count every firing in a leap.

id.description: Replicate index, 0 to `requested_replicates - 1`; it selects the random stream.

peak_instances.description: Largest number of distinct instances alive at once. On `tree` it includes the instance whose creation exceeded `max_instances`; the static methods reject that event before counting it.

rng_words.description: Random words, including product draws; the final event's product draws can take it past the sampling budget that stopped the path.

rule_events.description: Events per rule, in rule order.

saved_points.description: Report times filled with observable values: all of them for a completed or stopped replicate, the ones before the halt otherwise.

started.description: False for a replicate that never ran because the run was cancelled or hit its wall-time limit first; its counters are then zero.

stop_time.description: End of the horizon, the time the stop condition fired, or the time a limit or failure ended the path.

ResultVersion.description: The version of a result, its `schema` field.

RulesWaitingTime.description: How Static Direct draws waiting times (rules-run/0.4 and later).

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Statistics.description: Ensemble statistics per report time and observable, accumulated in replicate order so that they do not depend on the thread count.

mean_standard_error.description: Standard error of the mean, `sqrt(sample_variance / samples)`, under the same conditions as `sample_variance`.

quantiles.description: `crn-craft.result/1.0`: one entry per probability of the request's `outputs.quantiles`, in request order, each with the linear-interpolation quantile (NumPy's default, type 7; see the request field) of every report time and observable, indexed like `mean`. Present only when the request asked for quantiles; withheld with the other statistics.

sample_variance.description: Sample variance (divisor `samples - 1`), report time × observable; present when `variance` was requested and `samples` is at least 2.

samples.description: Replicates included: all of them, since statistics are withheld unless every replicate completed or stopped.

Termination.description:
How a replicate, or the whole ensemble, ended.

Values are ordered by severity, from `completed` to `output_limit`. The ensemble reports `completed` when every replicate completed or stopped, and otherwise the most severe replicate termination.

oneOf.description: The model's stop condition held, ATP was depleted under thinning, a continuous variable reached its lower bound with `on_bound: "stop"` under hybrid, or an observer stopped the replicate; the state is held to the end of the grid.

TrackerResult.description: The summary of one tracker over one replicate.

appearances.description: Changes from zero or below to a positive value. A value positive at time 0 opens an episode but is not an appearance.

episodes.description: The first `keep_episodes` episodes, in time order. An episode still open at the end is included if there is room.

extinctions.description: Changes from a positive value to zero or below.

first_passage.description: First time the `first_passage` predicate held; absent without a predicate or if it never held.

integral.description: Time integral of the observable from 0 to the end of observation (the replicate's stop time or horizon). A non-finite integral fails the replicate with `CRN-R030`.

last_appearance.description: Time of the last appearance, if any.

last_extinction.description: Time of the last extinction, if any.

maximum.description: Largest value, over the initial value and every post-event value.

minimum.description: Smallest value, over the initial value and every post-event value.

omitted_duration.description: Total duration of the omitted episodes.

omitted_peak.description: Largest peak among the omitted episodes; absent when none was omitted.

TypeHeader.description: A species type of the model, as listed in the result's `types`.

attributes.description: The type's attribute names, in the order of an instance's `attributes` values.

name.description: The type name from the model.

description:
The result of a `crn-craft.run/1.0` request: `crn-craft.result/1.0`, with the fields of `crn-craft.rules-result/0.3` plus `statistics.quantiles`.

A result is returned even when replicates hit limits or fail: check `termination`, the per-replicate records and `diagnostics`. Matrices are indexed by report time, then observable.

continuous.description: rules-result/0.3: the names of the continuous observable columns, in column order (continuous variables, or `ATP` of an ATP model). Their values are reported from the integrated or analytic flow, not only at events. Omitted when empty and before 0.3.

diagnostics.description: Ensemble-level diagnostics: `CRN-R050` for an incomplete ensemble, `CRN-R051` for a specialization that did not apply and `CRN-R045` for a trimmed result. Replicate errors are in their records.

final_instances.description: Final instances of the started replicates below `keep_instances`.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

observables.description: Observable names in column order: the model's observables sorted by name, then `ATP` for an ATP model or the continuous variables in declaration order.

observations.description: rules-result/0.2: tracker results and event logs, one entry per observed replicate in replicate order. Omitted when empty.

paths.description: Observable series of the started replicates below `keep_paths`.

replicates.description: One record per replicate, in replicate order.

report_times.description: The request's report times, one per matrix row.

rules.description: Rule names, in declaration order; `rule_events` and rule indices follow it.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact request bytes, lowercase hexadecimal. A parameter-bound candidate hashes its re-serialized request.

sampler.description: The sampler identity of the method that ran, for example `chacha8-u53/rules-direct/2`. Replays compare equal only under the same identity.

statistics.description: Withheld unless every replicate completed or stopped.

stopped_replicates.description: Replicates that stopped, a subset of `completed_replicates`.

termination.description: `completed` when every replicate completed or stopped; otherwise the most severe replicate termination.

types.description: The model's types, in declaration order.

title: RulesResult
